subject: Exec QBR pack: edit sweep & approval gate
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Exec QBR pack: edit sweep & approval gate

Team — attaching v2 of the exec QBR / investor update pack for a final edit sweep. High-level asks below; deck is intended for the June 22 investor briefing and the board packet. Please treat this as the single source of truth for slides we circulate outward.

Immediate asks (today by 4pm PT):
- Laura: slide 3 (go-to-market highlights) — tighten language on ARR motion and single most-important metric for the board. I pulled NRR and S&M efficiency but we need a one-line takeaway.
- Karthik: slide 5 (OKR dashboard) — freeze the OKR status columns and add a 30–60 day mitigation plan for any red/amber objectives. Also confirm the headcount forecast table numbers.
- Jonas: slide 9 (operational metrics & latency SLO) — refresh the latency P50/P95 numbers and call out the Dedicated capacity pilot impact.

Attachments: Redwood_Q2_Exec_Pack_v2.pptx (pptx), OKR-one-pager.xlsx (xlsx), QBR-talking-points.txt (txt).

Notes on tone: keep the investor-facing narrative crisp — facts + context + one ask per slide. No product deep-dives except the new Dedicated performance win on slide 9.

Thanks — I will consolidate edits and route to legal for the limited investor distribution copy this evening.

— Mina
Mina Haddad
Head of Strategy & Ops, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | mina@redwood.ai

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Exec QBR pack: edit sweep & approval gate

Thanks Mina — I ran a tight pass on slides 2–4. Major changes summarized below:
- Slide 3: Rewrote headline to "High-velocity GTM: 37% ARR growth; drive to efficiency via self-serve mix". Left a short blurb about conversion & PLG funnel.
- Metrics: replaced S&M efficiency with LTV:CAC trend (last 3 quarters) — easier for investors to parse.
- Suggested a 1-line ask for board: "Approval to extend Dedicated pilot to east-coast cluster to support enterprise commitments."

Questions for Karthik: the OKR sheet lists HC plan delta +8 FTEs vs last quarter — can you confirm hires are budgeted Q3?

Attached: quick redline export from the deck (annotated PPTX comments).

— Laura
Laura Bennett
Chief Revenue Officer
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 13:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec QBR pack: edit sweep & approval gate

Quick status: headcount forecast confirmed — +6 hires (3 eng, 2 sales, 1 infra) budgeted for July/August hires. I added a new column in the OKR-one-pager.xlsx called "Mitigation (30/60)" with short bullets for the two amber objectives.

On the OKR slide: recommended we consolidate two related objectives ("throughput" + "dedicated scale") into a single metric: "tokens/sec per GPU pool at P95" so the board can see the operational lever.

Also dropped a short note on runway sensitivity: at current burn and expected bookings, we have a 12–15 month runway; if enterprise expansions slip by one quarter runway drops ~2 months. Suggest we include that sentence in slide 6 (finance callout).

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
VP Product & Strategy
Redwood Inference

Added the latency table and a short note on the Dedicated pilot latency benefits. P50 improved ~8ms, P95 improved ~120ms in the pilot cluster — captured in slide 9. Also added a short SLO slide (slo: 100ms P95 for hosted; dedicated target 80ms).

A couple of asks before I hand off:
- Mina: please confirm whether we want to include the internal cost-per-token delta after quantization. If yes, I'll add a small callout in the cost slide.
- Laura: can you sign off on the investor-facing marketing bullets (I sanitized some product language).

— Jonas

Head of Engineering Operations
Redwood Inference

All — thanks for the quick turn. I consolidated edits, ran the deck by legal (limited-distribution watermark added) and finalized a short talking-points doc. Sending the limited investor copy to Maddy now.

Maddy — attaching the investor-facing deck for Monday's briefing. Quick context: we tightened go-to-market slides, added the Dedicated pilot latency wins, and included a runway sensitivity note on slide 6 per Karthik. We plan to open with a 3-slide executive summary, followed by OKR status (one page) and the ops/product highlights.

Ask: can you confirm receipt and whether the board would like a one-pager summary ahead of the call?

Attachments: Redwood_Q2_Exec_Pack_v2.pptx, QBR-talking-points.txt.
